segments.en:
Binzvanker's forces are meddling
in this universe too...
I've got to settle this fight fast...

If Quess can talk with Char, maybe we
could even get a ceasefire with
Neo Zeon...
But first I've got to stop Axis...

Lieutenant Kanji!
Come on out here a sec.
What?

What's up,
Kayra?

Well, y'know, you've been working
nonstop, right?

I'm fine.
I've still got plenty left in me.

Resting's part of the job too.
Pilots have been put on standby.

Kayra's right. At times like this,
the officers should be the first
to rest.

Otherwise your men won't feel
they can rest, right?
Oh... I see...

All right.
I'll do that.

Honestly...
these kids are such a handful.
So you'd noticed?

There's no way a Federation soldier
would be like that, right?

And that Balket-class battleship...
It's not from the Earth Sphere,
that's for sure.

I don't know where they came from,
but...

once this battle is over, I wouldn't
mind fighting for them.
Lieutenant...

Heeey!
Kanji~!
You're off duty now, right?
Yeah.

All right!
Then let's go see
Hathaway!

...Wait, were you guys
waiting for me?

Don't sweat the details.
Let's go!

rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'this universe' (Kanji and Kayra's later remark imply the heroes come from another world). Seg 5: [jp] -> Captain Kanji; seg 23: Kayra's [jp] addresses Amuro -> 'Captain...'. Seg 16: [jp] -- Kayra's 'kids' left unspecified (Kanji and his crew). Seg 18: [jp] read as 'no Federation soldier is like that' (about Kanji's group). | [editorial 12] clarity: the men hold back out of consideration and can't rest (accuracy flag)

segments.en:
Yo!
Hathaway!
We're back!

Oh!
You're all safe!

Of course we are!
We're pros, after all.

Oh ho! Looks like you've been
behaving yourself in your room.

I can't cause you any more
trouble, so...

...Yeah, right. I bet you were figuring
out how to sneak aboard an enemy
ship, weren't you?
Aha... hahahaha...

Hey, hey... Keep that to just
thinking about it, okay?

So...
did Quess show up?

No... We didn't run into any
mobile suit that looked like hers...

I wonder if a Newtype could tell
that kind of thing...
We can make a good guess!
How?

If Quess is coming out to fight as
a Newtype... she'd be in a mobile suit
to match, right?

So any MS that can use Funnels
is a suspect!

I get it! We just have to look
for one with Funnels.
So the fighting's still not over...

Axis is heading for Earth
right now.

We're about to go out
and stop it.

Next we're charging right into the
enemy's heart! We'll snatch Quess back
in all the confusion!

See you!
We'll come by again.

(The air aboard the ship feels
different than before...)

(The battle must not be
going well...)

rows.notes: Segs 22-23: thought lines in parentheses; the Japanese indent space on line 2 was not carried over. | [editorial 5] 'Says you' means disagreement, wrong idiom for [jp] ('you say that, but')

segments.en:
Our fleet will now launch a second
attack on Axis.

Federation forces everywhere have
started to move as well...

Once those fleets gather, the balance
of fleet strength will be reversed.

But... whether they can make it before
Axis falls is doubtful at this point.

So in this attack, we destroy Axis's
nozzles and stop its final acceleration.

After that, together with Federation
reinforcements, we destroy Axis itself!

The Neo Zeon fleet has already been
reinforced with units from Luna II.

With only our own forces, all we can do
is strike at their fleet, but...

we have only four nuclear missiles
left.
So, if that attack fails...

we board Axis directly and destroy it
from the inside.

Can you really pull that off
with just conventional explosives?

The core of Axis is riddled with a web
of mine shafts dug for resources.

If we blow those, splitting it is
possible -- on paper.

If the split works, most of Axis's
fragments will fly clear of
the atmosphere.

...Long story short, we've got no choice
but to ram the fleet in and latch onto
Axis, right?

And then we infiltrate Axis!
Sounds good to me!

That kind of thing's
our specialty, after all!
So it is.

Let's do it!
Captain Bright!!

Right!
A three-stage plan!!

With this attack, we settle this
in one go!

Fleet formation!
Complete!!
Time synchronization complete!

Right! All ships!
Move out toward Axis!!
Make sure you come back alive.

rows.notes: Seg 13: [jp] -> 'on paper'. Seg 20: 3[jp] -> 'three-stage plan' (fleet attack, nukes, boarding). Seg 25: Diane's listener unstated; plain imperative kept, no name added. | [editorial 14] 'fly off away from the atmosphere' clunky | [editorial 24] 'Launch toward Axis' odd for a fleet order

segments.en: Looks like we made it in time.

It was worth coming back
from Mars...
Indeed...!

If we hold Londo Bell here, Colonel
Char's victory will be assured!
Let's go!!

To fall here...
is no wasted death!!
Sieg Zeon!!

Just how many pro-Zeon forces are
there in this universe...

Tell me about it.
There's no end to 'em.

With things like this, no wonder
the Federation fleets can't leave
the colonies...

We are now entering
the combat zone!!

Dispersing Minovsky particles
at combat density!

Opening the mobile suit
deck!!

Amuro! The repairs
to the damaged sections
are completely done.
Thanks.
Well, I'm off!
Come back soon...

So the decisive battle is finally
here...

We can't lose
this fight.

I'll stop Axis in its tracks,
whatever it takes.

I won't let Neo Zeon
do as they please...
not anymore.

If I'm still in one piece, it's gotta
be thanks to this lucky charm...

Rose...
I wonder how she's doing...

Now comes the most important part.
I'm counting on you, Maggie!

Okaaay then~
Let's get started!

That Binzvanker guy
Kanji's up against...

seems like he's the key
to all this...

Now at last there's some hope
I'll get to see Linda again!

How long has it been
since then...

Not even being able to send a letter
is rough~

Okaaay!
For starters, let's smash
Axis to bits!

rows.notes: Seg 13: [jp] = Light's computer Maggie; -chan dropped. Seg 12: Rose = Rose Pattenton (library). Seg 17: [jp] -> Linda. | [editorial 11] awkward contraction 'in one piece's gotta be'

segments.en: The enemy fleet is charging at us!!

Deploy in front of the Rewloola!
We will protect the Colonel!

Good!
Send the Alpha Azieru to the front!

First wave of mobile suits has
launched from the Ra Chatter!

First time leading the charge in a while.
Let's show 'em what the Jegan squad's
made of!
Roger!

Leader!! Something huge
just showed up!

That machine isn't in our data...
It's a mobile armor!!
What do we do?!

The fleet's going in for a ramming run.
We'll deal with it ourselves!!
Let's go!!

Ufufu...
They're coming! They're coming!!
Leaderrr!!

Ahahahaha!
Fall! Fall! Fall!
Gwaaaaaah!!

Quess!
Don't get carried away!!

There's tons to do,
isn't there!

The Jegan squad's first wave
got wiped out?!

Looks like something real nasty
just showed up...
One of those Newtype things?
Don't tell me it's Char!

That machine... it's too innocent.
It's not Char...

Could it be...
Quess is in that...?!
Second wave, sortie!

Amuro!
Kanji!!
I'm counting on you!!
Roger!!
Guess we've got no choice!

rows.notes: [jp] -> Ra Chatter (not in glossary; official CCA spelling). [jp] (Jegan squad leader) -> 'Leader'.

segments.en: Engine output dropping!!
But the Colonel...!

Nanai,
you've done well.

The Rewloola will
take it from here.
We can still fight!

Axis's final acceleration is close.
There's no need to push yourselves.

Fall back while rescuing
our men.
Understood...

Fall back?! You've gotta be kidding!
I could handle them all by myself!

Then do your job
and protect the ship!!

No way!!
That's not my job!!
Quess!
Damage report?!

The Re-GZ's been hit!
It's out of action for now!!

MS "Re-GZ" and
MS "Re-GZ (BWS)"
have left the unit.
So we can't use the Re-GZ...

One more push.
I'm counting on you, Kanji!
Yeah...!

rows.notes: Seg 14: system message, three-line structure kept; Re-GZ (BWS) per glossary.

segments.en:
There's a hole in their defense line.
We can make it, Bright.

Right!
We're charging straight in!
Stay sharp on anti-air watch!!

All right!
Let's go!!

Hey...! Are we just gonna leave
that mobile armor alone?

That thing... Quess might
be in it, right?!

That mobile armor looks like
it's come back into our area.
It can still fight...?!

I won't let you get
to the Colonel!!
So that malice has come...
Quess!

Quess...
That's not the way!

The mobile suit deck... Isn't there
anything here I can fly...?

Hm?
Is that... Chan?!

The more Psycho-Frame out there,
the better the odds for Amuro!!

What are you saying?!
Stop it!
Chan!!

Quess is inside
that light...!
Here it comes!

That mobile armor looks pretty worn
out from the last fight... but don't
underestimate it!

Damn...! So Quess is
in that thing...!

Is she really
in there...?

Our friend over there is
spoiling for a fight!

Ignore it for now.
Stopping Axis comes first!

Light!
Blind it!!
Roger!

Here's a little something
special for you!
Ahh!!

It worked! Looks like
it's lost its bearings.

Is it okay to just
leave it...?

Nobody can keep fighting
like that without resupply.

It doesn't have the firepower left
to wipe out the fleet.
Ship No. 4 has entered Axis.

Good! Set the nuclear bombs to go off
just before it hits Earth. Bring
the crew back aboard.

Colonel, we've recovered
Gyunei's squad, but...

Quess is cut off
among the enemy.

So Amuro's putting her through
the wringer... It's the difference
in experience.

The Rewloola and my squad
will hold them here.

Nanai, take over the Rewloola's
combat bridge.
So you're going out after all.
No one but me can stop Amuro.

Heh...
I'm going out!
We're almost there!!

Once we break through that,
we fire the nuclear missiles!!

rows.notes: Seg 7: [jp] -> 'So that malice has come...'. Seg 12: Chan is launching in a machine to add Psycho-Frame for Amuro. Seg 33: [jp] -> 'being put through the wringer'. | [editorial 19] 'raring for a fight' not idiomatic; awkward 'there's' contraction

segments.en:
All units out there, return!
We're withdrawing from this area!

Colonel!! It's time!!
Please fall back for now!

Not yet!
Londo Bell's missiles are coming!
Lyle!!

Open the gun ports!
Full salvo!
Incoming fire!!
Evade!!
Waaaaaah!!
The Ra Chatter!!

The Ra Chatter
is shielding us!!

Target!
The nuclear nozzles!!

Axis!
It's accelerating!!

Just slam them right
into the base!!
Fiiire!!
Which one is the nuke...
Funnels!!

The nuclear missiles
have been stopped!

Bring the Ra Cailum
alongside Axis!

All hands, prepare for
ground combat!!

<Win Condition>
1. Break through the enemy defense line
2. Annihilate the enemy

Ra Cailum secured to Axis!
We've sent in the demolition team!
What's the enemy fleet doing?!

Here they come!!
Dead ahead!!

What are they up to... The Ra Cailum
has stopped moving.

They mean to destroy Axis
from the inside...

Now's our chance
to sink the Ra Cailum.

The Sazabi's maintenance is done,
I trust? I'm going out too!

Amuro! I won't let you
go any further!!

So you've come!
Char!!
Amuro!!

Why can't you understand that
the humans left on Earth are nothing
but fleas on the ground?!!

You don't know the first thing
about remaking the world...!

Revolutions are always
started by intellectuals,

and since they chase dreamlike goals,
all they ever do is go to extremes!

I have no thought of
remaking the world!!

This from a man whose talents
are used by the ignorant masses!
Is that so!!
If only you weren't here!!

rows.notes: Seg 8-10: CCA intellectuals/revolution exchange; Amuro's [jp] rendered as 'You don't know the first thing about remaking the world'. | [proofread 7] question punctuation: a direct question ended in '!' only; '?' added per style sheet ('?!')

segments.en:
New enemy!! A mobile armor-class
unit is approaching!
It's that one!!

What's with that thing?
It's falling to pieces...
Was it acting on its own?!

Ufufu... The psycommu's pulling me
along, so you won't get away!
I can still move!!
Here I come!!
Hah... hah...

Quess...
where are you...?
Ah! There he is!

Hathaway!
Get back here!!

Look who's talking, Chan!
Coming out in a machine like that!!

This is...
for the Psycho-Frame's...

Wait! Hathaway!
The mobile armor!!
Huh?!

It's you in there, isn't it, Quess?!
You're in this thing!!

Isn't he getting a bit too
familiar...? This guy......

No!
You'll die!!

Hathaway!
Get out of the way!!
That one!!
Hah... hah...
Don't, Quess!

That's why all you ever make
is enemies!

You too...
saying stuff like that...!

That's why... I have to destroy the
Earth that gave birth to people like you!
Or no one'll ever be saved~!!
Open the hatch!

Once you see my face, you'll forget
all that irritation in no time!

I hate kids!
They're so pushy!!
Whoa!

Hathaway!
Get out of the way!!
That girl is dangerous!!
Nasty woman...

If it weren't for you, I could've
stayed with Amuro...!
Stayed with Amuro...?

Don't tell me...
that girl is...?

Quess!
Get out of there!!
Hathaway!!
Queeess!!

Quess's machine
went down?

How come? We didn't do enough
damage to blow it up, did we?

I've been picking up a strange
transmission for a while now.

Damn it...! The Minovsky particles
are so thick, it's taking forever
to analyze!
Ahh...

Hathaway!
Are you all right?
Chan...

It was you, Chan!
You did it!!

Stop it!
What you're doing is--
You shouldn't have done it!

Grown-ups don't get that, and that's
why they can wipe out even the Earth
without batting an eye!
Hathaway!

Light! What's happening?!!
What is that light?!

Ugh...
Th-This is...

What's wrong?
Light!!

Hey! Don't we have bigger
things to worry about right now?

You're right... We're surrounded
by enemies. We can't let our guard
down!!

Light!!
Keep watch!
Roger......

rows.notes: Seg 17: [jp] -- Quess spotting Chan; kept as 'That one!!' (neutral). Seg 46: Chan is cut off mid-sentence, left unfinished. Seg 47: [jp] -- Hathaway tells Chan she should not have done it. | [editorial 48] clumsy cleft 'that, that grown-ups' | [proofread 46] interrupted line (Chan is cut off, per row note) had no closing mark; '--' added so it reads as a cut-off, not a typo | [proofread 51] question punctuation: a direct question ended in '!' only; '?' added per style sheet ('?!')

segments.en: It's almost time!

Captain Bright! Axis is going to blow!
Pull back!!
Sink the Rewloola!
One more push and it'll go down!

No way! We're falling apart
over here too!!

Forget that, Ra Cailum! You'd better
get outta here, fast!!

Go while we
hold them off!
Understood...

Ra Cailum,
full astern!!

Hm!
I've been hit?!

Colonel! We're at our limit!!
Please fall back!!

...!!
The Rewloola is withdrawing?!
You're telling me to come back...!

Nanai!!
Don't come between men!!
Gwah!!

Colonel!! Are you going
to abandon us?!
Axis is splitting...

Woohoo!
We did it!!

Hahaha!
Don't get hit by the debris!
Light! Are you okay?!
Yeah... more or less.
I've been caught?!
But it's too late now!!
What's the status of Axis?!

Axis split confirmed. The front section
is pulling away from Earth.

But the explosion put the brakes
on the rear section, so...
It's lighter now, so it shouldn't fall!

The explosion that split Axis
was too big!
Did I... just help Char...?!

It's my fault! Axis was more fragile
than I calculated...

rows.notes: Seg 9 [jp] / seg 21 [jp]: Char's exclamations kept short with 'I' as the reading (his machine is hit, then caught). Seg 13: CCA line [jp]. | [editorial 25] 'got braked by the explosion' awkward | [proofread 29] question punctuation: a direct question ended in '!' only; '?' added per style sheet ('?!')

segments.en: Heh heh heh heh heh...
Hahahahahaha!!
What are you laughing at?
I've won.

I just ran the numbers. Earth's gravity
will pull the rear half of Axis down!
You people tried too hard!
Don't give me that!!

It's just one rock!!
I'll push it back with the Gundam!!
Stop this foolishness!
You never know until you try!!

I'm not in as much of a hurry as you,
and I haven't despaired of humanity!
Are you insane?!
Axis has already started to fall!!
The Nu Gundam isn't just for show!!
New fleet detected!
It's a Federation fleet!
Reinforcements?!

It's the Earth Federation
Forces, right?!
No doubt about it!!

The Konpei Island Fleet!
And the 88 Fleet is with them too!!

Axis is still falling!
It's not stopping!
Looks like its tip has caught fire.

So at last the cavalry
makes its entrance, eh?

Mm...! All ships, ready your Micro CS
Cannons! We'll vaporize Axis!!

Micro CS Cannons,
standing by to fire!!
Beginning energy charge!!

With this, we can prove that our
fleet is the strongest force there is.

Let's hope it doesn't put them
too much on their guard...

Commander! Transmission
from Special Officer Omega!!
Hmph! At a crucial moment like this!!
It's fine. Put him through!
C-Commander!

We're connected with
Special Officer Omega!

For a while now, I've been observing
a strange energy at the tip of Axis.
You seem interested.

I have an idea of the cause. This may be
an unreasonable request, but would you
call off the bombardment?
As if that would fly!

If the Earth freezes over,
it's all been for nothing!!

There is no need for concern.
Our fleet also has Axis within range.

With a concerted attack,
we can vaporize Axis.

Heh... So you think there's
something to be gained?

Very well.
I'll have the bombardment halted.

All ships, hold fire!!
But keep your sights on target!!

Mobile suits are coming
in ahead of the fleet?
What's going on?

And they're all
heading for Axis...

Captain Bright! Incoming message
from Commander Rochina!!

"Ra Cailum is to recover damaged
units"... that's the message!
What happened to Amuro?
Looks like he's still on Axis.

Maybe that light... is the Psycho-Frame
light Chan was talking about...?!
Amuro's still out there, isn't he...
Hey, should we go too?
Well, duh!

Yeah... If we give up,
then it's over!!

You guys... are a bunch of
hopeless optimists, you know that?
C'mon! Let's go!!

Yeah, yeah.
I'm coming along!

Even the Dragonar Team?!
Stop, it's impossible!

Kanji, you shouldn't have
any stake in this world!

You don't have to get
mixed up in this!
Huh... So you knew.

But y'know, Amuro, I'm already
part of this world!

That's right! Let us lend you
a hand, Amuro!!

Haha, if this works, it's settled:
Amuro's buying!
Oh! I like the sound of that!
All right, let's give it everything!

Stop it, you don't need to get
involved in this!

It's about whether the Earth
is done for or not.

It's worth a shot,
I tell ya!

It's no use...
Everyone, fall back!!

You'll just blow yourselves up from
friction heat and overload!!

rows.notes: [jp] (Omega's rank, original Redros rank, not in glossary) -> 'Special Officer'. [jp] -> '88 Fleet' (not in glossary). [69-70] Neo Zeon soldier's Kansai-ish [jp] rendered as folksy 'ain't it'. [40] Binzvanker addresses Omega ([jp]). [3] [jp] -> 'I've won.' | [accuracy 20] [jp] = Axis isn't stopping; 'We can't stop it' added an attempt by Redros that the scene doesn't have | [editorial 70] [jp] is a flat folksy assertion; tag question 'ain't it' turned it into a request for agreement (accuracy flag)

Micro CS Cannons,

rows.notes: Identical text to row 22 [20-42]; same translation. [jp] -> 'Special Officer' (unverified). | [accuracy 0] same as row 22 k20 (identical duplicate text)

segments.en: That's enough!
Everyone, stop!!

Sooner or later, nothing but this kind
of sorrow will spread and crush the Earth.

If so, then mankind must
judge itself with its own hands

and atone to nature,
and to the Earth!

Amuro...
Why can't you understand that?!!

Get away!!
The Gundam's power is...!!

Wh-What is this?
Psycho-Frame resonance?!

Is it overloading because too much
human will is concentrated in it?!
I feel no fear...

If anything, it's warm...
and to think I feel at peace...
But...

It's people with this very warmth
who would even destroy the Earth!
Understand that, Amuro!!
I do understand!

That's exactly why we have to show
the world the human heart, isn't it!!
Uaaaaaagh!!

Ohh... ohh...
The Colonel...

Hey!
What's wrong?
That's impossible!!

Confirmed: Axis
is changing course!

It's moving away
from the Earth!!
This is...

A band of light...
is wrapping around the Earth...

rows.notes: [3]/[4] one sentence split across two pages, cut at the same point. [18] Nanai sobbing ([jp]) -> 'Ohh... ohh...'. | [accuracy 11] restored the surprise of [jp] (Char astonished that he feels at peace) | [editorial 9] silent page ellipsis made consistent with the rest of the unit | [proofread 5] question punctuation: a direct question ended in '!' only; '?' added per style sheet ('?!')
